payload.taskDescription: Create prototype/style-tile.html and prototype/style-tile.css as a dependency-free, file-URL-openable page with three labeled directions. Each direction shows a cork surface, three pin styles, a red association string, a dashed amber provenance string, a period heading over system body text, and one 44px control. Include a short legend explaining what the reviewer should judge. Use only local CSS, inline SVG, and system or bundled font stacks; no network requests, external images, or external fonts. Add a Playwright test that opens the file URL and asserts the three directions, both string types, the type samples, and no horizontal overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844.
